steps.narration: The source digest advances while the container's prebuild snapshot stays pinned, so its fingerprint trails the current source.

The prebuild is rebuilt and re-fingerprinted against the current source digest.

The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current container row.

drills.notes: Missing lifecycle-hook truth withholds the devcontainer claim and blocks promotion rather than letting an ungated hook run during hydration.

steps.narration: The devcontainer declares a post-create hook with no trust-gate evidence binding it to the hook-review lane.
Lifecycle-hook-truth evidence is observed missing for the devcontainer target class.
The certification withholds the devcontainer claim and blocks promotion; hydration is held until the hook is trust-gated rather than silently executed.
The hook is surfaced as a trust-gated review object and the evidence is restored.
Lifecycle-hook-truth evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current devcontainer row.

steps.narration: The managed-cloud capsule digest ages past its freshness window after a defining input changes upstream of the mirror.
Capsule-identity evidence is observed stale for the managed-cloud target class.
The certified claim narrows to preview and the warm-start posture drops to a cold build; the stale capsule can no longer prove the cached environment matches the current source.
The capsule digest is recomputed and re-mirrored against the current defining inputs.

The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current managed-cloud row.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed target class with partial evidence on any required aspect narrows to at most a beta claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Partial lane evidence proves only part of the claimed environment, so the target class may not present a stable environment guarantee.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed target class with stale evidence on any required aspect narrows to at most a preview claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Stale lane evidence may no longer reflect the current source or platform truth, so the target class drops below beta until the evidence is refreshed.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed target class missing evidence on any required aspect is withheld and blocks promotion until the aspect is proven.
freshness_rules.rationale: A required environment aspect with no backing lane evidence cannot be proven, so the target class may not be promoted at its claimed maturity.

invariants: Each claimed M5 target class is certified only when every required environment aspect — capsule identity, template composition, prebuild compatibility, lifecycle-hook truth, and runtime-instance parity — is proven current against its frozen upstream lane.

One narrowing engine folds per-aspect evidence into a verdict and a warm-start posture: partial evidence narrows to beta, stale evidence narrows to preview, missing evidence withholds the claim, and stale or partial capsule/prebuild evidence narrows warm reuse.

A withheld target class blocks promotion; the rolled-up promotion decision can never report green while any claimed local, container, remote, devcontainer, or managed target class cannot prove every aspect.

Prebuilds and capsules are accelerators rather than authorities: a warm-full-reuse claim drops to partial reuse or a cold build whenever the capsule identity or prebuild compatibility outruns current truth, so a target class that opened once cannot stay green on stale evidence.

The certification only narrows, never widens; a target class absent from the packet is uncertified rather than implicitly green, and the lane never silently widens a claim beyond the target classes the packet proves.
Release, support, docs, and help all read the same per-row verdict, warm-start posture, narrowing tokens, and promotion decision instead of re-deriving environment staleness.

promotion.summary: Every claimed target class is certified at its claimed maturity and warm-start posture; the environment lane may be promoted.

aspects.rationale: The capsule object is identified by a typed, versioned digest and certified across its seven capsule dimensions, so identity is inspectable, diffable, and mirrorable rather than implied by side effects.
Template hydration composes the same capsule object with workflow-bundle, archetype, and docs layers, so a starter cannot fork the execution or trust model from the core capsule.

Prebuild reuse is keyed on a compatibility fingerprint over source, capsule, platform, policy, extension, and toolchain inputs, so a drifted fingerprint invalidates the snapshot instead of serving it as current truth.
Repo-defined lifecycle hooks are surfaced as trust-gated review objects, so policy-denied or restricted hooks become visible holds rather than silent side effects during hydration or warm start.

The runtime instance materialized for the capsule — process namespace, mounts, ports, service readiness, and secret projection — stays semantically aligned with the capsule's declared target across desktop, CLI, AI, and support.

surface_bindings.summary: The shiproom dashboard reads the per-row verdict, effective maturity, warm-start posture, and the rolled-up promotion decision, and holds promotion for any narrowed or withheld release-scope target class.
The metadata-first support bundle re-exports the per-row verdict, narrowing tokens, warm-start posture, and stale-or-missing aspects without raw paths, credentials, or provider payloads.
The reviewer documentation quotes the certified aspects, freshness and warm-start rules, per-row verdicts, and the promotion decision directly from the packet.
The in-product why-this-environment inspector reuses the same verdict and warm-start vocabulary so help never tells a greener story than the packet.

warm_start_rules.effect: Partial capsule-identity or prebuild-compatibility evidence narrows the warm-start posture to at most partial reuse.
warm_start_rules.rationale: A partially proven capsule or fingerprint cannot prove the whole cached environment matches the current source, so only part of the environment may be reused.

warm_start_rules.effect: Stale capsule-identity or prebuild-compatibility evidence forces a cold build.
warm_start_rules.rationale: A stale capsule or fingerprint can no longer prove the cached artifact matches the current source, so the environment must be rebuilt rather than served warm.

warm_start_rules.effect: Missing capsule-identity or prebuild-compatibility evidence forces a cold build.
warm_start_rules.rationale: Without a capsule identity or fingerprint the environment cannot be identified for reuse, so warm start is unavailable and the environment is rebuilt cold.
